{{Quote|Hopefully we'll be able to intercept a few Jedi before they walk into this catastrophe.|Bail Organa speaks to Sheltay Retrac, Sateen Vestswe, and Raymus Antilles|audio=Bail-Catastrophe-ROTS.flac|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Sheltay Retrac''' was a [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. [[Reproduction|Born]] to [[Alderaanian]] [[Noble|nobility]], she served as the head of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa's]] team of [[aide]]s in the [[Alderaanian delegation]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], she walked through a corridor of Organa's [[consular ship]], the ''[[Tantive III]]'', with the senator while he spoke about aiding members of the [[Jedi Order]] following the Republic's recent issuing of [[Order 66]], which declared the [[Jedi]] [[Treason|traitors]].

==Biography==
Sheltay Retrac was a [[human]] who was a child of [[Alderaanian]] nobility from the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], she served as the head of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa's]] team of [[aide]]s, working alongside fellow aides [[Agrippa Aldrete]]<ref name="HC34" /> and [[Sateen Vestswe]]. Organa was a member of the [[Alderaanian delegation]] in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate]] and also part of the [[Delegation of 2,000]], which meant Retrac and his other aides needed to be loyal and willing to keep many secrets for him, as well as protect him, during such dangerous [[time]]s.<ref name="VE" />

[[File:VestsweTantiveIII-ROTS.png|thumb|left|320px|Left to right: Sheltay Retrac, Bail Organa, Sateen Vestswe, and Raymus Antilles]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> the Republic issued [[Order 66]], which declared members of the [[Jedi Order]] traitors and led to many of them being [[Death|executed]]. Organa was keen to aide those [[Jedi]] who still lived, and after his [[consular ship]],<ref name="ROTS" /> the ''[[Tantive III]]'',<ref name="VE" /> took off from the planet [[Coruscant]], he walked down one of the [[Starship|ship's]] corridors towards the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] with Retrac, Vestswe, and [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]] while saying that they had to try and intercept any Jedi who had not yet been killed. Organa then successfully helped [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] survive.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Retrac had tan skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]].<ref name="HC34" />

==Equipment==
Retrac preferred simple white [[Clothing|robes]],<ref name="HC34" /> and while on the ''Tantive III'', she wore a cream-colored dress and matching [[Cloak|cape]] with a silver headpiece. She wore a [[Kueget LN-21 blaster pistol]] on her right hip<ref name="ROTS" /> and also carried a [[stun blaster]] for if she ever had to defend herself or Organa.<ref name="HC34" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Warrenfu-costume.jpg|thumb|250px|Warren Fu's design for Padmé Amidala's original costume, which evolved into Sheltay Retrac]]
Sheltay Retrac was portrayed by [[Caroline de Souza Correa]]<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/episode3/story/Bail_Organas_Aide_Talks_Episode_III_92848.asp|text=Bail Organa's Aide Talks Episode III|author=Britany|date=2005-05-24|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20220730084142}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The actress filmed for four days,<ref name="TFN" /> with the scene aboard the ''Tantive III'' being filmed on Stage 7 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 24]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> She also filmed an additional scene that was ultimately cut in which she, Organa, and Vestswe are stopped by two [[Senate Guard]]s.<ref name="VideoVillage">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/me3|text=Making Episode III Webdocs - "Video Village"}}</ref>

Retrac's dress, designed by art director of visual effects [[Warren Fu]], was originally meant for Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to reflect her white [[Geonosis]] costume and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] diplomatic costume. However, the design was rejected for Amidala as her clothing needed to conceal her [[Reproduction|pregnancy]], and it was instead reassigned to Retrac.<ref name="Art of ROTS">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Retrac was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|character]] was first mentioned prior to the release of Episode III in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[April 2]], 2005.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref>
